scope.selection: Exactly tasks.jsonl IDs crossed with r1/r2/r3 filenames in runs/V2; no chk, trivial, discarded, or other variant logs.

extraction_rules.pairing: Exact tool_use.id = tool_result.tool_use_id within the same log; only tool_use name mcp__skillfetch__load_skills.
extraction_rules.accepted_ids: Exact parsed tool_result.content.skills[].id from returns without is_error:true, semantic error, malformed skills, or conflicting payloads; errors[] retained independently. Requested and resolve_set IDs are not accepted as returns.
extraction_rules.result_copy_check: Compare paired tool_result text JSON with top-level tool_use_result.structuredContent and content when present; retain conflicts, never silently union them.
extraction_rules.absent_error_flag: NO_ERROR_FLAG means is_error was absent, not explicitly false. Parsed successful skills payloads remain actual return evidence.
extraction_rules.oracle_matching: Only stage5/oracle.jsonl: exact task ID and full returned skill ID (including hash or path) against pool[].skill. Missing grade stays null. No grading or basename/path normalization.
extraction_rules.relevance: grade >= 2 in the existing pool is the relevance threshold. oracle_no_grade_gte2 describes the pool, not an inferred absence of all useful skills.
extraction_rules.final_status: All selected recordings retained, including error_max_turns; session result is not a task-quality grade.

condition.name: V0 plus one project-root CLAUDE.md line
condition.expected_claude_line: Before your first tool call on any coding task in this repository (anything beyond a one-line edit, a rename or a question), run the `skillfetch-router` skill and follow its steps.
